note: Measures the window on a read-only copy of one real chat (the user's own data, never the live folder): copy one chat folder from %APPDATA%\Ensemble\chats to %TEMP%\ensemble-demo-surfreal\chats (no accounts, connectors or usage files) and put its id in the openChat step below. Run without -Fresh: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\shoot-own.ps1 -Name surfreal -Script scripts\visual\perf-real.json -TimeoutSec 400. Delete the copy and the screenshots afterwards. Same measures as perf-window.json.
